fullDescription: Dark glassmorphism button system: frosted-glass buttons over an aqua + magenta aurora background, with tinted, ghost and aurora-gradient variants, three sizes, hover/loading/disabled states, and a full variants-by-states canvas.

structured.summary: A frosted-glass ('glassmorphism') button SYSTEM page for dark interfaces: an ambient aurora background (blurred aqua + magenta blobs over near-black ink, plus a faint grain), a sticky translucent glass nav, a centered hero, and below it the full button spec laid out as living documentation: a 6-variant grid, a three-size row, a four-state row, and a variants-x-states matrix canvas. The transferable value is the button language itself, every button is a translucent glass surface with an inset top highlight and a soft drop shadow that lifts and glows on hover, tinted aqua, magenta, neutral, or filled with the aurora gradient for the single primary action.

style.description: Dark glassmorphism with an aurora accent palette. Near-black ink base (#0b0f14), cool aqua (#2dd4bf) and warm magenta (#e879f9) as the only two accents, everything else is translucent white glass and slate-grey text. Depth comes from layered light: an inset 1px white top-highlight on every surface, soft black drop shadows for elevation, and colored glow shadows on hover. Type pairs Space Grotesk (display/headings/labels) with Inter (body/UI). Generous spacing, large rounded corners, and a quiet, premium, never-loud feel.
style.prompt: Design in a dark glassmorphism style. Base background is near-black ink #0b0f14 with an ambient aurora field behind everything: three large heavily-blurred (blur ~90px) radial blobs, aqua rgba(45,212,191,.42) top-left, magenta rgba(232,121,249,.38) mid-right, and a mixed aqua/magenta blob bottom-center, all at ~0.55 opacity, plus a fixed fractal-noise grain overlay at 0.035 opacity for texture. Accent palette is exactly two colors: aqua #2dd4bf and magenta #e879f9; never introduce other hues. Surfaces are frosted glass: linear-gradient(145deg, rgba(255,255,255,.07), rgba(255,255,255,.02)) with a 1px rgba(255,255,255,.10) border and backdrop-filter blur(16px) saturate(140%); cards use a slightly softer blur(14px) and lower-alpha fill. Every raised element carries an inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.18) top highlight plus a soft black drop shadow 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.35). Text is light slate: white #ffffff and slate-200/300 for headings, slate-400 for body, slate-500 for captions and code labels. Typography: headings, eyebrow badges and mono-style code labels use Space Grotesk; body and UI use Inter, both via Google Fonts; tracking is tight on display (letter-spacing -0.01em), wide and uppercased on eyebrow badges (letter-spacing .12em). Corners are large and soft (buttons .65-.95rem, cards rounded-2xl/3xl). Keep it calm and premium: lots of negative space, low-alpha translucency, color used sparingly and only to glow.

layout_and_structure.description: Single centered column on an ambient aurora background, max-width ~72rem (max-w-6xl), 1.5-2rem horizontal padding. Top-to-bottom: sticky glass nav, centered hero with a palette strip, then four documentation sections each introduced by a numbered eyebrow badge + heading: 01 Variants (responsive card grid), 02 Sizes (one glass panel), 03 States (4-up card row), 04 Canvas (a variants-x-states matrix in a big glass panel), then a glass-topped footer. Reflows from 3-col to 1-col on mobile; the matrix becomes horizontally scrollable.

prompts.prompt: Fixed full-viewport aurora field behind all content (z-0): three position:absolute blurred radial blobs, .blob-aqua 46rem top:-16rem left:-10rem aqua-tinted, .blob-magenta 42rem top:28rem right:-14rem magenta-tinted, .blob-mix 38rem bottom:-16rem left:30% mixed; each border-radius:9999px, filter:blur(90px), opacity .55. Above it a fixed grain overlay (z-1) using an inline SVG fractalNoise data-URI at opacity .035. All pointer-events:none. Main content sits at z-10.

Sticky top-0 header (z-40) that is a frosted-glass bar (.glass) with a 1px bottom white/10 border. Inside, a max-w-6xl row, h-16, space-between: left = brand lockup (an 8x8 rounded-lg gradient chip from #2dd4bf to #e879f9 holding a ph:circles-three-fill icon in #06231f, next to 'Aurora' in white + 'UI' in aqua, Space Grotesk 700); center = 4 text links (Variants, Sizes, States, Canvas) in slate-300 that go white on hover, hidden on mobile; right = a ghost 'Docs' button (hidden on small) and a solid aurora-gradient 'Copy system' button with a copy icon.

Centered hero, max-w-6xl, pt-20 pb-10, text-center. Top: a small glass pill with a glowing aqua dot reading 'Frosted-glass button system . v2.4'. Then a huge Space Grotesk 700 headline 'Buttons that catch' / 'the light.' where 'the light.' uses a bg-clip-text gradient from aqua to magenta; size text-5xl up to lg:text-7xl, leading 1.05, tight tracking, white. Below, a max-w-2xl slate-400 subhead. Then a centered button row: solid aurora-gradient 'Explore the set' (lg) + frosted-glass 'Open the canvas' (lg), both with leading icons. Finally a centered palette strip: four 2.25rem rounded swatches (ink solid, aqua gradient, magenta gradient, frosted glass) with a mono caption 'ink . aqua . magenta + frosted glass'.

Every section opens with a numbered eyebrow badge in Space Grotesk, uppercase, letter-spacing .12em, ~11px, colored aqua or magenta (alternating), e.g. '01 . Variants', then a Space Grotesk 700 heading text-2xl/3xl in white. Optionally a right-aligned slate-400 one-line descriptor on wider screens. Sections are max-w-6xl, py-10.

Responsive grid, gap-4, 1 col on mobile, 2 at sm, 3 at lg. Six glass-card tiles (rounded-2xl, p-5), each with a header row: a Space Grotesk 600 white label (Frosted / Aqua tint / Magenta tint / Primary / Ghost / Icon set) and a right-aligned mono slate-500 class name (.btn-glass etc). Below sits a full-width sample button of that variant with a leading icon, then a 2-line slate-500 caption describing when to use it. The Icon-set tile instead shows a row of four square (!px-3) icon-only buttons, one per tint.

A faint vertical aqua wash sits behind this section. One glass-card panel (rounded-2xl, p-6/8) holding a 3-col grid (stacks on mobile). Each column is a size: 'sm . 13px', 'md . 15px', 'lg . 17px' as a mono slate-500 label, then a solid 'Get started ->' button and a frosted 'Secondary' button at that size, left-aligned, so the size rhythm reads down the columns.

A 4-up grid (1/2/4 cols responsive) of glass-card tiles, each centered: a single aqua (or frosted) button shown in one state, with a mono caption under it. States: :default, :hover . glow (the hover tile has an aqua-tinted border and the button frozen in its lifted+glowing hover style), :loading (label hidden, a spinning ring centered), :disabled (opacity .4, grayscale, not-allowed).

The spec table. A large glass-card (rounded-3xl, p-8/10, dramatic 0 30px 80px rgba(0,0,0,.5) shadow) containing a CSS grid: first column ~120px row-labels, then 4 equal state columns. Header row of mono uppercase tracked labels: Default / Hover (aqua) / Loading / Disabled. Then five rows, one per variant (Primary, Aqua, Magenta, Frosted, Ghost), each showing that variant rendered in all four states across the row. Wrap in an overflow-x-auto container with a min-width so it scrolls horizontally on small screens. Caption below in slate-500: '5 variants x 4 states . built on the aurora palette . Inter + Space Grotesk'.

Glass-topped footer (border-t white/10), max-w-6xl, py-10, stacked on mobile / row on sm with space-between: left = the brand lockup again (smaller gradient chip + AuroraUI), center = a slate-500 one-liner 'A frosted-glass button system for dark interfaces. Made on an infinite canvas.', right = three icon links (GitHub, Figma, X) in slate-400 that turn aqua on hover.

special_ui_components.prompt: Translucent neutral button: background linear-gradient(150deg, rgba(255,255,255,.09), rgba(255,255,255,.025)), 1px rgba(255,255,255,.14) border, color #e7ecf3, backdrop-filter blur(14px) saturate(150%), box-shadow inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.18), 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.35). On hover: translateY(-2px), brighter border rgba(255,255,255,.28), stronger inset highlight + 0 14px 36px rgba(0,0,0,.45). Base .btn is inline-flex, gap .5rem, font-weight 600, letter-spacing -.01em, border-radius .8rem, transition transform .22s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1); :active translateY(1px) scale(.99).

background linear-gradient(150deg, rgba(45,212,191,.22), rgba(45,212,191,.07)), 1px rgba(45,212,191,.42) border, color #d6fff7, blur(14px), box-shadow inset 0 1px 0 rgba(168,255,240,.35), 0 8px 26px rgba(45,212,191,.10). Hover: translateY(-2px), border rgba(45,212,191,.7), glow inset 0 1px 0 rgba(168,255,240,.5), 0 0 0 1px rgba(45,212,191,.25), 0 14px 40px rgba(45,212,191,.42), color #effffb.

background linear-gradient(150deg, rgba(232,121,249,.22), rgba(232,121,249,.07)), 1px rgba(232,121,249,.42) border, color #fbe3ff, blur(14px), box-shadow inset 0 1px 0 rgba(252,214,255,.35), 0 8px 26px rgba(232,121,249,.10). Hover: translateY(-2px), border rgba(232,121,249,.72), glow inset 0 1px 0 rgba(252,214,255,.5), 0 0 0 1px rgba(232,121,249,.25), 0 14px 40px rgba(232,121,249,.42), color #fff0ff.

The one filled button, reserved for the single main action per view. color #06231f, font-weight 700, background linear-gradient(135deg, #2dd4bf 0%, #6ee7df 45%, #e879f9 130%), 1px rgba(255,255,255,.25) border, box-shadow 0 8px 26px rgba(45,212,191,.32), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.5). Hover: translateY(-2px) with a dual-color glow 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.3), 0 16px 44px rgba(45,212,191,.5), 0 8px 30px rgba(232,121,249,.35).

background transparent, 1px rgba(255,255,255,.16) border, color #aeb8c6. Hover: translateY(-2px), color #eef3f8, border rgba(45,212,191,.55), background rgba(45,212,191,.06), box-shadow 0 10px 30px rgba(45,212,191,.18). For dismissals and tertiary paths.

Three sizes sharing one rhythm. sm: font .8125rem, padding .45rem .85rem, radius .65rem. md: font .9375rem, padding .62rem 1.15rem (default radius .8rem). lg: font 1.05rem, padding .82rem 1.5rem, radius .95rem. Icon-only buttons drop horizontal padding to a square footprint via !px-3.

Loading: add .is-loading to hide the label (color transparent) and disable pointer-events, plus an absolutely-centered .spinner (a 1.05em ring, 2px rgba(255,255,255,.3) border with white top, spin .7s linear infinite; on the solid button the ring is dark #06231f). Disabled: .is-disabled sets opacity .4, cursor not-allowed, grayscale(.3) and neutralizes hover transforms.

Reusable primitives: .glass (nav/pills) = linear-gradient(145deg, rgba(255,255,255,.07), rgba(255,255,255,.02)), 1px white/10 border, blur(16px) saturate(140%); .glass-card (content cards) = softer linear-gradient(160deg, rgba(255,255,255,.045), rgba(255,255,255,.012)), 1px white/7 border, blur(14px). .swatch = 2.25rem rounded chip with white/12 border and inset top highlight, used to show the ink / aqua-gradient / magenta-gradient / frosted-glass palette.

structured.special_notes: Token reference for faithful reproduction. Tailwind config extends colors: ink #0b0f14, aqua #2dd4bf, magenta #e879f9. Fonts: display family Space Grotesk (weights 500/600/700), body family Inter (400/500/600/700), both from Google Fonts; 'mono' utility reuses Space Grotesk for code-style labels. Icons are Phosphor via Iconify (e.g. ph:circles-three-fill, ph:sparkle-fill, ph:rocket-launch-fill, ph:arrow-right-bold). Primary-gradient text color is the dark teal #06231f (sits on the bright gradient). Layout is max-w-6xl with px-6 lg:px-8. The page reads as documentation: this is a design SYSTEM showcase, so every variant, size and state is shown side-by-side, not a marketing page. Reproduce the exact rgba alpha values, they ARE the look (low-alpha translucency + inset highlight + colored glow). No em-dashes in copy.
